newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-T-bonds may claw back 108-30 but seen down.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-T-bonds may claw back 108-30 but seen down.

text.p: June T-bond futures are faced with a bleak chart outlook after the market's breach of the key 108-30 support level on Tuesday, technical analysts said on Wednesday.
"Yesterday's break of 108-30 is pretty important. For the most part we could build below here," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London.
T-bonds could attempt to claw back some of the losses in the near term and possibly reach back above 108-30 and 109-02, the close on May 22. But this would be "a bit of a dead cat bounce".
By 0925, the June T-bond future was up 1/32 at 108-24.
"Whenever you have a sharp breakdown you come back and try to retrace some of it," said Celaya.
But overall a rock-solid top formation above the market with a peak at 110-22 struck on May 13 would ensure that any upside gains would be limited.
While the market held below 108-30, downside targets were 107-08 and 107-03, Celaya said.
But for Wednesday, T-bonds could see gains to 108-11, the high on April 23, and 108-12, the low on April 30.
If the market managed to plough above 109-02, then upside targets would be extended to the area between 109-10 and 109-12.

Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST in London, said the market had found suppport at 108-17 which is a 50 percent retracement of the move from a low of 106-02 to the May 13 high of 110-22.
"If we can get above 108-24 we would look for a rally to the 109-00 area," Whitby said. But supply would come into force at 109-07, limiting any further gains.
Whitby pegged initial support at 108-21, followed by 108-19 and 108-17. "If that does break the rally scope is negated," she said.
